news.title: Stripe in Talks for $10 Billion OpenRouter Deal to Boost AI-Powered Payments
news.body: Stripe is reportedly negotiating a $10 billion acquisition of OpenRouter, an AI startup, to enhance its payment processing with machine learning for fraud detection, underwriting, and merchant automation. If finalized, Stripe could roll out new AI-driven features that automate risk assessment and streamline onboarding, directly challenging rivals like Adyen and PayPal in product speed and intelligence.

news.title: Verifone Patents Tamper-Detection for Payment Terminals, Raising Security Standards
news.body: Verifone has secured a US patent for technology that enables payment terminals to detect physical tampering in real time, alerting merchants and acquirers to potential breaches. This advancement gives Verifone a competitive edge in hardware security, and competing terminal providers must accelerate their own security upgrades to retain clients in high-risk sectors.

news.title: MoonPay Adds Discover Network, Expanding Card Access for US Crypto Users
news.body: MoonPay now supports Discover Network cards for crypto transactions in the US, allowing more consumers to buy and sell digital assets directly with their existing credit and debit cards. This integration increases MoonPay’s reach among US cardholders, prompting other crypto payment providers to pursue similar partnerships to maintain market share.

news.title: Zelle Faces Lawsuit Over Fraud Losses, Pressuring Banks to Revamp Reimbursement Policies
news.body: A US judge has allowed a lawsuit from New York’s Attorney General against Zelle to proceed, alleging insufficient fraud protections for users. This decision exposes Zelle and its bank partners to reputational and legal risk, and they must overhaul fraud reimbursement policies to comply with potential new consumer protection regulations.

news.title: Bitwave Launches Open-Source AI Suite to Automate Digital Asset Finance
news.body: Bitwave has released its Agentic Suite, open-source tools that automate reconciliation, reporting, and compliance for digital asset organizations using AI. By enabling real-time back-office automation, Bitwave directly challenges legacy financial software vendors that rely on manual processes, pushing fintechs and digital asset firms to adopt agentic workflows for efficiency.

perspective: Stripe’s OpenRouter talks and Zelle’s fraud lawsuit highlight how AI and compliance are reshaping payments innovation and risk management.

curiosity.text: The Electronic Payments Network (EPN), which processed the first U.S. e-check in 1984, laid groundwork for today’s real-time digital payment systems and fintech innovation.
